methods.M1_top2_cosine: Label-centric RAG: top-2 chunks per category by cosine similarity (text-embedding-3-small), one LLM call per category. Matches the web UI.
methods.M2_top1_cosine: Label-centric RAG: single best chunk per category by cosine similarity.
methods.M3_top1_cosine_llmcheck: M2 (top-1 cosine) plus one LLM verification pass per contract over the full contract + all 41 categories + candidate answers, reasoning to prune hallucinations and recover clear misses.
methods.M4_top1_bm25: Label-centric RAG: single best chunk per category by BM25 (lexical) retrieval instead of cosine similarity.
methods.M5_section_top2_cosine: Section chunking (1.1/1.2 reading order, ~1500 chars) + top-2 chunks per category by cosine similarity. Tests whether finer chunks help retrieval.
methods.M6_section_hybrid_bm25_cosine: Section chunking + HYBRID retrieval: BM25 prefilter to top-10 chunks, then cosine-rerank those to top-3, and answer from those 3 chunks.
methods.M7_section_hybrid_top5: Section chunking + HYBRID retrieval: BM25 prefilter to top-10 chunks, then cosine-rerank to top-5 (wider final budget than M6's top-3).
